$comment: The universal fleet no-phone-home / no-telemetry env knobs. THE one list: the shell-rc bridge, the CI setup action, telemetry-env-is-disabled.mts, and spawned AI agents all derive from here. It lives beside the setup action rather than under .claude/hooks/ because the action reads it at RUNTIME on a bare runner, before a thin member has hydrated its fleet payload, so it has to sit on a path every member tracks. Sorted by name, per the fleet socket/sort-* convention.

knobs.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC
knobs.note: Claude Code master no-phone-home switch (telemetry + error reporting + autoupdater + non-essential model calls). Set for completeness even though Claude Code also honors DO_NOT_TRACK.

knobs.name: COREPACK_ENABLE_PROJECT_SPEC
knobs.note: Disable corepack — it is deprecated (removed from Node core) and the fleet never enables it. 0 makes corepack ignore package.json spec, so a stray shim cannot enforce a package manager; pnpm is declared via devEngines.packageManager and provisioned out-of-band.

knobs.name: DISABLE_TELEMETRY
knobs.note: Generic telemetry opt-out honored by Claude Code and several CLIs.

knobs.name: DO_NOT_TRACK
knobs.note: Cross-tool opt-out standard (consoledonottrack.com); honored by @socketsecurity/lib prim (the vendored Claude Code runtime) and any future tool that reads it.

knobs.name: NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER
knobs.note: Disables the npm + pnpm update-notifier registry phone-home. Universal (all platforms) — previously mis-scoped under the macOS-only list, which is why CI runners never received it.

knobs.name: OTEL_SDK_DISABLED
knobs.note: Master OpenTelemetry SDK no-op (spec-defined: the SDK reads this and exports nothing). The skillspector security tool bundles langgraph-api, whose closure ships opentelemetry-sdk + an OTLP exporter; this knob holds that exporter inert on every fleet surface. Value is the string "true" — the SDK does NOT treat "1" as disabled.
